title: Haatoun Pe Laashe Asghar Leker Chale Hai Sarwar
body:
Haatoun pe laashe Asghar leker chale hai Sarwar
<<MINI>>
Ruk ruk ke roo rahe hai khud apni bekasi per
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Laayeh uthake Sarwar sub akroba ke lashe(2) lekin hai Karbala me ab dard ka yeh manzer(2)
<<MINI>>
Ruk ruk ke roo rahe hai khud apni bekasi per
Haatou pe lashe Asghar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2 Insaan zalimou me koi nahi hai dekho(2)
Tere sitam chala hai shashmah ke gaale per(2)
<<MINI>>
Ruk ruk ke roo rahe hai khud apni bekasi per
Haatou pe lashe Asghar (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Dhaste bala me sheh ko ab koun de sahara(2)
Abbas bhi nahi hai Qasim hai aur na akber(2)
<<MINI>>
Ruk ruk ke roo rahe hai khud apni bekasi per
Haatou pe lashe Asghar(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Humraah Fatima bhi sar peethti chali hai(2)
Gurbat pa shah e deen ki ab roote hai payamber(2)
<<MINI>>
Ruk ruk ke roo rahe hai khud apni bekasi per
Haatou pe lashe Asghar(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Manka dhala huwa hai shashmah khoo me tar hai(2)
Kya haal hoga uska dekhigi jab yeh madar(2)
<<MINI>>
Ruk ruk ke roo rahe hai khud apni bekasi per
Haatou pe lashe Asghar(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Baba meri taraf se Asghar ko pyaar karna(2)
Sarwar tarap rahe hai sughra ka khat ye(2)
<<MINI>>
Ruk ruk ke roo rahe hai khud apni bekasi per
Haatou pe lashe Asghar(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Kaise bayaan ho Mohsin ahwaal Karbala ka(2)
Har dum nayi musibat thi jaan e mustafa per(2)
<<MINI>>
Ruk ruk ke roo rahe hai khud apni bekasi per
Haatou pe lashe Asghar(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz..Mohsin kamaal..
